consumer: The find-item quest's possession gate evaluated by condition.cpp::set_has_items (u_has_items/npc_has_items), asking 'does the character actor have flashlight?' as a yes/no the engine computes.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory), matching the possession gate's reach.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_items — builds the dialogue condition lambda that returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, producing the engine-computed yes/no the gate consumes.
divergence: A flashlight that exists only as charges inside a held container/tool so has_charges() returns true, while a flat type_id scan over the avatar.carried_items[] snapshot (which lists the container, not a 'flashlight' entry) reports absent — the re-derived answer flips the gate.
